neighbours.label: the digit '3' immediately after the letter O in a formula or acronym (SO3, Fe2O3, WO3, AO3, O365); 3 after other letters, other digits after O, and free-standing 3 stay low
fire: Rust is largely iron oxide, Fe2O3, which forms on wet steel.
Sapphire is a crystal of aluminium oxide, Al2O3, tinted by traces of metal.
Nitric acid, HNO3, is a strong acid used to make fertilizer.
The nitrate ion, NO3, is common in groundwater near farms.
Thin films of tungsten oxide, WO3, change colour when charged.
High in the stratosphere, ozone, O3, absorbs ultraviolet light.
Potassium chlorate contains the chlorate group, ClO3, and is used in matches.
Most of my favourite stories are archived on AO3 under that tag.
quiet: Rust forms when iron reacts with water, H2O, on wet steel.
Sulfur dioxide, SO2, is released when coal is burned.
Phosphine, PH3, is a toxic gas with a garlic smell.
The phosphate ion, PO4, is common in groundwater near farms.
Boron trichloride, BCl3, fumes strongly in moist air.
High in the atmosphere, carbon dioxide, CO2, traps heat.
The match factory employs 3 chemists and a safety officer.
Most of my favourite stories are archived on the site under tag 3.
